photos.title: The Patricia Grand from above
photos.what: The Patricia Grand from above (USDA NAIP aerial photo, 2023): the oceanfront condo building, white towers with swimming pools on the ocean side, stands on the beach at the middle left; other oceanfront buildings run along the beach; the Atlantic Ocean fills the lower right. Labels placed from coordinates (labels.json).
photos.caption: The Patricia Grand from above, on the beach on North Ocean Boulevard.
photos.alt: Aerial photo of the Patricia Grand oceanfront condo building on the beach in Myrtle Beach, labelled, with the Atlantic Ocean beside it
photos.author: USDA Farm Service Agency, NAIP
